name: Valfin
description: Valfin was an astronomical object in the Valfin system in the Meram sector of the Outer Rim Territories. During the New Republic Era, it hosted a penitentiary outpost by the New Republic Correctional Corps and N5 sentry droids were deployed as prison guards there.
lead_paragraphs: Valfin was an astronomical object in the Valfin system in the Meram sector of the Outer Rim Territories. During the New Republic Era, it hosted a penitentiary outpost by the New Republic Correctional Corps and N5 sentry droids were deployed as prison guards there.
